title: Admin sets courtesy visit policy
description: Courtesy grace days and extra visits live on Payment Plans. Courtesy check-ins appear on the Attendance Log Admission column.

steps.title: Courtesy settings
steps.body: On Payment Plans, Payment Provider & Courtesy Settings controls grace days, extra visits, and admin notify-on-courtesy.
steps.resultNote: Courtesy grace days are visible on Payment Plans.

steps.title: Courtesy on Attendance Log
steps.body: A courtesy visit shows Admission as Courtesy. Suspend courtesy on a member’s Plan screen if they should not use grace.
steps.resultNote: Attendance Log includes a courtesy visit from the tutorial seed.
